title.narrative: Enhancing Food Security and Livelihood Resilience for Vulnerable Drought-Affected Populations in Laas Qoray District

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project is designed to mitigate the effects of drought in drought-affected pastoral and rural IDP households in Habar-Shiro, Balibusle, Buraan, Sibaayo, Ceelaayo,Kaladhacda, Durduri, Ulxeed of Laas Qoray District by delivering immediate, life-saving assistance and sustaining essential services for 3,879 acutely vulnerable individuals including 392 PLWDs across the target locations using a multi-modal cash-led convergence approach. The intervention addresses acute consumption deficits and asset depletion through three components unconditional cash transfers (UCT), emergency livestock inputs (cash+), and conditional cash for assets/cash for work (CfA/CfW). 335 households (reaching approximately 2010 individuals) will receive Cash+ assistance via MMTs at $65 per HH/month for three months, covering approximately 70% of the food MEB needs to immediately stabilize household purchasing power and avert hunger. 270 most affected livestock-dependent households receive animal feeds of 2,430 bags of emergency animal fodder (3 bags, 30Kg each/HH/Month*3 months) to avert irreversible livestock asset depletion exacerbated by persistent dry conditions. 120 vulnerable individuals (48 W, 72 M) will receive Conditional Cash Transfers (CCT) for work @ $65 over three months to rehabilitate six strategic water infrastructure assets (canals/berkeds) providing temporary income while simultaneously ensuring sustained access to an improved water source for at least 80% of the targeted population. The intervention targets stabilization of household purchasing power and food consumption for 455 households comprising 335 C+ and 120 CCT HHs (equating to 2,730 individuals via the application of the standard x6 household multiplier) while delivering comprehensive protection and accountability services reaching a total of 3,879 individuals including 392 PLWDs across all modalities. The project rigorously applies the Centrality of Protection (HNRP SO3) through Vulnerability Based Targeting (VBT), prioritizing Pregnant and Lactating Women (PLW), children under five (CU5), Persons with Disabilities (PWDs), and marginalized/minority clans to mitigate exclusion risks. Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP) is ensured through SADDD collection, proactive outreach measures, PSEA compliance, and the operation of an accessible, confidential Complaints and Feedback Mechanism (CFM) including the toll-free line (325) to ensure principled, dignified, and safe assistance delivery. The project will run for 6 months from December 2025 to May 2026.lt/pgt
